about: Schema errors that already existed when scripts/dbcheck.js was introduced. The check fails on any error NOT listed here. Fix one, delete its entry, and it can never come back unnoticed. Do not add to this list to make the check pass.

known.sql: SELECT dc.id, dc.platform, dc.client_name, dc.case_type, dc.status, dc.started_at, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM drip_messages WHERE campaign_id = dc.id) AS msg_to
known.why: drip_campaigns is defined twice with different columns (db.js at start-up; the one-time /admin/api/migrate-wave2 endpoint in admin.js). The drip code expects the second shape. Which one the live database has decides the fix.

known.sql: SELECT dm.*, dc.platform, dc.platform_id, dc.client_name, dc.status as campaign_status FROM drip_messages dm JOIN drip_campaigns dc ON dm.campaign_id = dc.id WH
known.why: Same cause as the dashboard.js entry: drip_campaigns has two definitions and the drip queue reads columns only one of them has.
